attributes.scope_note: 142 tasks: 85 within-cohort tasks and 57 cross-cohort survival tasks; each held-out cohort counts as a separate task. review.method_note: Independent review pass. The Zenodo PDF was re-downloaded and its SHA-256 and MD5 checked against the source record and the Zenodo file checksum; the three HTML sources were refetched and all three hashes matched. The report prints no tables, so npm run batch -- check-values cannot place any locator and reports locator_not_parsed for all 101 results; value-check.tsv is kept as that record. All 101 were therefore re-read by review/check_figure_labels.py, written for this pass and using neither of the extractor's scripts: it reads the word-level geometry of a pdftotext -bbox-layout run and places every cell by its x and y coordinates, so each value is tied to the row whose label it sits beside and to the column or panel whose printed header it sits under, rather than to a line of a -layout text layer or a character offset. Figure 2's three panels and Figure 17's two columns were resolved by clustering the value positions and ordering the clusters by the printed headers; every printed 95% interval was matched to the result's uncertainty bounds. 113 checks, no disagreement. Three arithmetic constraints were re-derived: Figure 17's five per-lineage Pearson r values average to the bottom chart's overall r for both Ladon (0.872 against a printed 0.87) and CIBERSORT (0.594 against 0.600), which independently fixes which of the two numbers in each lineage label is Ladon's; Figure 2's pan-cancer bar differs from the mean of its two transfer bars, as the caption requires; and Figure 14's in-figure top-5% label agrees with the page 27 prose. A manual sample was read by eye from the -layout text layer: all 24 Figure 2 cells, all 14 Figure 3 OS and PFS values, all 10 Figure 18 AUCs with their intervals, and the Figure 5, 11, 12a, 13 and 17 readouts, with column and panel assignment checked in each. Figure 2's 24 cells, Figure 3's 14 and Figure 18's 10 AUCs and intervals were confirmed a third time against the facet and row keys of the authors' own figure pages.

evidence_concerns.message: The T-effector / IFN-gamma response AUROC is an equal mean over six trials, and one of the six, POPLAR, is the trial the signature was derived on: this page states 'The T-effector signature was derived on POPLAR, so its POPLAR result is in-sample.' One sixth of the stored mean is therefore a training-set score. Nothing in the evaluation's comparison fields records it, and the report's own Figure 6 text does not state it, so a reader comparing this mean with a T-effector / IFN-gamma AUROC measured out of sample would be comparing unlike numbers. The printed value is kept as published and this entry withholds it from automatic comparison. It covers that one result: the other nine Figure 6 results, the protocol and the method record are not affected, and the per-trial values are not stored.
